Single process mass-harvesting browser, wallet & password-manager credential stores (Dolphin X sweep) AIActions on Objectives Medium
Detects one non-machine-account process reading four or more distinct credential stores (Chromium/Gecko Login Data, wallet extension settings, desktop wallet keystores, KeePass vaults) within a 5-minute window — the Dolphin X stealer sweep across 9 browsers, 100+ wallet extensions, 65 desktop wallets and 10 password managers. Includes the known sample SHA256 as a booster. Rationale: Built from the article's explicit collection scope (9 browsers, 100+ wallet extensions, 65 desktop wallets, 10 password managers) expressed as a same-process fan-out across distinct credential file types in a tight window — the behaviour that distinguishes a stealer sweep from normal browser use. Sample SHA256 added as a high-confidence override. Cross-checked against: • https://www.theregister.com/security/2026/07/22/sneaky-windows-stealer-targets-300-apps-gives-crims-an-ai-profiler-to-maximize-profits/ • https://gbhackers.com/windows-stealer-uses-ai-profiling/
ATT&CKT1555.003 T1555.005 T1555
Data sourcesEndpoint.Filesystem
Expected false positives · estimated rate: medium — model-assessed, tune to your environment
  • Endpoint backup / migration agents (e.g. profile-sync, browser-import tools) reading multiple browser profile files at once
  • Enterprise password-manager clients or browser-sync services touching vaults and Login Data
  • Antivirus / EDR full-disk scans opening credential SQLite files during a scheduled scan
  • Browser itself updating multiple profile stores after an upgrade
  • Forensic / DLP agents inventorying credential files
Suppression filter
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("msmpeng.exe","mbamservice.exe","backup.exe","veeam.agent.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe") and InitiatingProcessFolderPath !startswith "C:\\Program Files"
Response runbook
1) Triage: inspect InitiatingProcessFileName, folder path and SHA256 — a signed browser/backup tool is likely benign; an unsigned binary in %TEMP%/%APPDATA% or one matching the sample hash is malicious. Confirm the process also beaconed to thedolphinx.top. 2) Contain: isolate the host and reset all browser-saved, wallet, and password-manager credentials plus any crypto seed phrases; assume full compromise of stored secrets. 3) Hunt: pivot on the process SHA256 org-wide, check the developer-secret harvest UC for .env/.ssh/.aws access by the same process, and review outbound uploads to backend.thedolphinx.top.
let window = 5m;
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("FileAccessed","FileModified","FileRenamed","FileCreated")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| extend LowerPath = tolower(FolderPath), LowerName = tolower(FileName)
| where (FileName in~ ("Login Data","Login Data For Account","key4.db","logins.json","cookies.sqlite","Web Data"))
    or (LowerPath has @"\local extension settings\")
    or (LowerName endswith ".kdbx")
    or (LowerPath has @"\ethereum\keystore")
| summarize DistinctStores = dcount(FileName), Stores = make_set(FolderPath, 25), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
    by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessSHA256, bin(Timestamp, window)
| where DistinctStores >= 4 or InitiatingProcessSHA256 == "726e7fe23560fe03ea36163d5f510b494f41a78bf811c92ff219f64b4bfe2be0"
| order by FirstSeen desc
let window = 5m;
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where isnotempty(ActingProcessName)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| extend LowerPath = tolower(TargetFilePath), LowerName = tolower(TargetFileName)
| where (TargetFileName in~ ("Login Data","key4.db","logins.json","cookies.sqlite","Web Data"))
    or (LowerPath has @"\local extension settings\")
    or (LowerName endswith ".kdbx")
    or (LowerPath has @"\ethereum\keystore")
| summarize DistinctStores = dcount(TargetFileName), Stores = make_set(TargetFilePath, 25), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, bin(TimeGenerated, window)
| where DistinctStores >= 4
| order by FirstSeen desc
source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*\\Login Data* OR *\\key4.db* OR *\\logins.json* OR *\\cookies.sqlite* OR *\\Web Data* OR *\\Local Extension Settings\\* OR *.kdbx OR *\\ethereum\\keystore*)
#event_simpleName=/^(FileOpenInfo|FileWritten)$/
| TargetFileName=/(\\Login Data|\\key4\.db|\\logins\.json|\\cookies\.sqlite|\\Web Data|\\Local Extension Settings\\|\.kdbx$|\\ethereum\\keystore)/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextProcessId, ContextImageFileName], function=count(field=TargetFileName, distinct=true, as=DistinctStores))
| DistinctStores >= 4
ENDPOINT
Toggle if your env has no CIM data-model acceleration.
| tstats `summariesonly` count values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_path dc(Filesystem.file_name) as distinct_stores min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name IN ("Login Data","key4.db","logins.json","cookies.sqlite","Web Data") OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\*" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.kdbx" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ethereum\\keystore*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process_id _time span=5m | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where distinct_stores>=4 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| tstats summariesonly=false count values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_path dc(Filesystem.file_name) as distinct_stores min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name IN ("Login Data","key4.db","logins.json","cookies.sqlite","Web Data") OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\*" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.kdbx" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ethereum\\keystore*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process_id _time span=5m | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where distinct_stores>=4 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
Single process harvesting developer & cloud secrets (.env, SSH keys, AWS/GCP/kube configs) AIActions on Objectives Medium
Detects one non-machine-account process reading three or more distinct developer/cloud secret types (.env files, ~/.ssh private keys, .aws/credentials, gcloud config, .kube/config) within a 10-minute window — the Dolphin X developer/DevOps credential-collection capability that sets it apart from a commodity browser stealer. Rationale: Directly encodes the article's stated developer-secret theft (.env files, SSH keys, cloud access tokens, cloud CLI configs across 30+ cloud CLI tools) as a same-process multi-secret-type access burst — the DevOps-targeting angle that multiple sources call out as Dolphin X's distinguishing collection behaviour. Cross-checked against: • https://www.theregister.com/security/2026/07/22/sneaky-windows-stealer-targets-300-apps-gives-crims-an-ai-profiler-to-maximize-profits/ • https://www.technadu.com/dolphin-x-new-windows-stealer-uses-ai-to-rank-which-victims-are-worth-robbing/631754/
ATT&CKT1552.001 T1552.004 T1528 T1005
Data sourcesEndpoint.Filesystem
Expected false positives · estimated rate: medium — model-assessed, tune to your environment
  • Developer running a legit build/deploy that reads .env, ~/.ssh and cloud CLI configs (CI runners, terraform, kubectl, aws-cli sessions)
  • IDE / editor (VS Code) indexing a workspace containing .env and config files
  • Backup or endpoint-DLP agent scanning home directories
  • Secret-scanning security tools (gitleaks, trufflehog) walking dev machines
  • Configuration-management agent (Ansible/Chef) reading credential files
Suppression filter
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("code.exe","terraform.exe","aws.exe","kubectl.exe","gcloud.exe","git.exe","python.exe","node.exe","ssh.exe","gitleaks.exe","trufflehog.exe") and InitiatingProcessFolderPath !startswith "C:\\Program Files"
Response runbook
1) Triage: check whether the InitiatingProcess is a known dev tool (code.exe, terraform.exe, aws.exe, kubectl.exe, git.exe) — those are usually benign; an unsigned binary in %TEMP%/%APPDATA%, or one matching the sample hash / beaconing to thedolphinx.top, is malicious. 2) Contain: isolate the host and immediately rotate every exposed secret — SSH keys, AWS/GCP access keys, kube tokens, and any credentials in the read .env files — then review cloud audit logs (CloudTrail/GCP audit) for use of those keys from unfamiliar IPs. 3) Hunt: pivot on the process SHA256 org-wide and correlate with the browser/wallet sweep UC and outbound uploads to backend.thedolphinx.top:8443.
let window = 10m;
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("FileAccessed","FileModified","FileRenamed","FileCreated")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| extend LowerPath = tolower(FolderPath), LowerName = tolower(FileName)
| where (LowerName == ".env" or LowerName startswith ".env.")
    or (LowerPath has @"\.ssh" and (LowerName startswith "id_" or LowerName endswith ".pem"))
    or (LowerPath has @"\.aws" and LowerName in~ ("credentials","config"))
    or (LowerPath has @"\gcloud")
    or (LowerPath has @"\.kube" and LowerName == "config")
| summarize DistinctSecretPaths = dcount(FolderPath), Secrets = make_set(FolderPath, 25), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)

| order by FirstSeen desc
let window = 10m;
ImFileEvent

id: 7c8b2e10-4d4f-4a8c-9c1f-bf6e2c4a8d02
status: experimental
description: |
    Stealers / wallet drainers read keystore files from MetaMask,
    Exodus, Atomic, Phantom, Bitcoin, Electrum, Ethereum-cli wallets.
    Filtering out the legitimate wallet binaries leaves only attacker
    activity.
references:

author: Clankerusecase
date: 2026/05/02
tags:

    - attack.collection

    category: file_access
    product: windows
detection:

        TargetFilename|contains:
            - '\Ethereum\keystore\'
            - '\Bitcoin\'
            - '\Exodus\'
            - '\Electrum\wallets\'
            - '\MetaMask\'
            - '\Phantom\'
            - '\Atomic\Local Storage\'
    filter_legit:

            - '\Exodus.exe'

            - '\electrum.exe'
            - '\Bitcoin.exe'
            - '\Phantom.exe'
    condition: selection_path and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
    - Backup software
level: high

Infostealer — non-browser process accessing browser cookie/login DBs Actions on Objectives High
Stealers (RedLine, Lumma, Vidar, Atomic) read Login Data / cookies SQLite from Chrome/Edge/Firefox.
ATT&CKT1539 T1555.003
Data sourcesEndpoint.Filesystem DeviceFileEvents
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\Google\Chrome\User Data\", @"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\", @"\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\")
| where FileName in~ ("Login Data","Cookies","logins.json","cookies.sqlite")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FolderPath, FileName, ActionType

// ASIM ImFileEvent — covers MDE, Sysmon, AuditD, Defender for Cloud, etc.
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Google\Chrome\User Data\",
                                  @"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\",
                                  @"\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\")
| where TargetFileName in~ ("Login Data","Cookies","logins.json","cookies.sqlite")
| where ActingProcessName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName,
          TargetFilePath, TargetFileName, EventType

title: Infostealer - Non-Browser Process Accessing Browser Credential Stores
id: 7c8b2e10-4d4f-4a8c-9c1f-bf6e2c4a8d01
status: experimental
description: |
    Stealers (RedLine, Lumma, Vidar, Atomic) read Login Data / cookies
    SQLite databases from Chrome/Edge/Firefox profile directories. Any
    non-browser process touching these files is a high-fidelity signal.
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1539/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1555/003/
author: Clankerusecase
date: 2026/05/02
tags:
    - attack.t1539
    - attack.t1555.003
    - attack.credential-access
logsource:
    category: file_access
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_path:
        TargetFilename|contains:
            - '\Google\Chrome\User Data\'
            - '\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\'
            - '\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\'
    selection_file:
        TargetFilename|endswith:
            - '\Login Data'
            - '\Cookies'
            - '\logins.json'
            - '\cookies.sqlite'
    filter_browser:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\chrome.exe'
            - '\msedge.exe'
            - '\firefox.exe'
            - '\brave.exe'
            - '\opera.exe'
    condition: selection_path and selection_file and not filter_browser
falsepositives:
    - Backup utilities reading user profile files
    - Browser sync agents from non-stock vendors
level: high
ENDPOINT
Toggle if your env has no CIM data-model acceleration.
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where (Filesystem.file_path="*\Google\Chrome\User Data\*\Login Data*"
        OR Filesystem.file_path="*\Google\Chrome\User Data\*\Cookies*"
        OR Filesystem.file_path="*\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\*\Login Data*"
        OR Filesystem.file_path="*\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\*\logins.json*"
        OR Filesystem.file_path="*\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\*\cookies.sqlite*")
      AND NOT Filesystem.process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe")
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.process_name, Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where (Filesystem.file_path="*\Google\Chrome\User Data\*\Login Data*"
        OR Filesystem.file_path="*\Google\Chrome\User Data\*\Cookies*"
        OR Filesystem.file_path="*\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\*\Login Data*"
        OR Filesystem.file_path="*\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\*\logins.json*"
        OR Filesystem.file_path="*\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\*\cookies.sqlite*")
      AND NOT Filesystem.process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe")
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.process_name, Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
